project_type: npm-workspaces monorepo (packages/*, apps/*, tools/*). This task builds apps/api as a NestJS modular monolith. apps/ and apps/api do not exist yet — greenfield within the workspace.
build_system: npm workspaces at repo root. apps/api compiles with nest build (tsc, CommonJS). QUIRK: packages/shared ships RAW ESM TypeScript (packages/shared/package.json has "type":"module", main/types = src/index.ts, no build output) — it CANNOT be cleanly imported into apps/api's CommonJS tsc build, and packages/shared MUST NOT be modified. Therefore MIRROR the shared types into apps/api/src/shared/contract.ts verbatim (the task explicitly permits 'Import/mirror these'). QUIRK: packages/content has NO package.json; it is plain JSON read from disk at runtime, not a workspace dependency.
test_framework: Jest via ts-jest. Unit specs: *.spec.ts (jest.config.js). E2E: *.e2e-spec.ts with supertest (jest-e2e.config.js). Run from apps/api.
build_command: cd apps/api && npm run build   (runs nest build / tsc -p tsconfig.build.json)
test_command: cd apps/api && npm test   (jest unit). E2E: cd apps/api && npm run test:e2e
verification_instructions: 1) From apps/api: npm run build passes with zero TypeScript errors. 2) From apps/api: npm test passes, covering content loading + both phase endpoints, roles guard deny/allow, caregiver-only-linked-learner access, progress read/write ownership, AI guardrail routing a health question to human/professional help. 3) From apps/api: npm run test:e2e boots the Nest app and GET /api/phases returns an entry with id phase-01. 4) From repo root: npm run content:validate still passes (do not break the existing root test gate). Build and tests must NOT require a running database or network/API keys.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Prisma client is generated by `prisma generate` from apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma, but generation MUST NOT be part of build or test (no live DB / client needed for in-memory path). Do not check in generated Prisma client. null otherwise.
environment_constraints: No live PostgreSQL available — the app must build and unit-test using the in-memory repository implementation (selected when DATABASE_URL is unset). No network or LLM API keys available — the AI module must use the deterministic local stub LlmProvider. Windows/PowerShell shell. Node 24. Do NOT run `npm run dev` servers as a verification step.
contribution_requirements: CONSTRAINTS (hard): only create/modify files under apps/api, PLUS additive scripts in the root package.json (never clobber the existing root "test" which runs content:validate — add a separate api test script), and root tsconfig only if strictly needed to wire the workspace. Do NOT touch packages/content, packages/shared, tools/, apps/web, or apps/mobile. Guiding principles (.kiro/steering/guiding-principles.md): modular monolith (NOT microservices); shared types in packages/shared are the contract (mirror, don't diverge); child-data protection is structural (data minimisation, caregiver-mediated minor accounts, role-based access on every read/write, no behavioural ad profiling, exportable/deletable data; align with India DPDP Rules 2025); the platform strengthens and never replaces parents/teachers/doctors/relationships — health/safety/wellbeing questions route to human/professional help.
key_patterns: Content loading pattern lives in tools/pdf/lib.mjs: resolve repoRoot from a known anchor, contentRoot = repoRoot/packages/content, loadCatalog() reads catalog.json, loadPhases() iterates catalog.phases in order and reads each entry.file that existsSync (skipping unauthored). apps/api must mirror this at runtime and MUST NOT hardcode a phase list (phases 02..13 are authored concurrently and must appear automatically). Shared contract types are in packages/shared/src/index.ts: DevelopmentDomainKey, Audience, AgeRange, DevelopmentDomain, YearPlan, Activity, GuidanceItem, Milestone, Project, AppFeature, Source, Phase, CatalogEntry, Catalog, UserRole ('learner'|'parent'|'guardian'|'educator'|'admin'), ProgressRecord (userId, phaseId, itemKey, status 'not-started'|'in-progress'|'completed', updatedAt). Routes are under global prefix 'api' (app.setGlobalPrefix('api')).
relevant_files: docs/architecture.md (module list: content, auth, users, progress, ai; modular monolith)
packages/content/phases/phase-01/phase.json (shape of a full phase; phases 02,03 also on disk)
tools/pdf/validate-content.mjs (how the root content gate validates)
package.json (root — add scripts only: test:api/dev; do not clobber "test")
README.md (npm run dev runs web + api together)
directory_structure: packages/shared (raw-ESM TS types, do not touch), packages/content (JSON curriculum + schema, do not touch), tools/pdf (content validation + pdf gen, do not touch), apps/ (to be created; only apps/api is in scope), docs/ (architecture + vision). Target layout under apps/api is specified in apps/api/.agents/tasks/plan.md.
